processes.label: P3-tree-before
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $all=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process); $ids=[Collections.Generic.HashSet[uint32]]::new(); $null=$ids.Add(32256); do {$added=$false;foreach($p in $all){if($ids.Contains([uint32]$p.ParentProcessId) -and $ids.Add([uint32]$p.ProcessId)){$added=$true}}}while($added); @($all | Where-Object {$ids.Contains([uint32]$_.ProcessId)} | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,ExecutablePath,CommandLine,CreationDate) | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 -Compress

processes.label: P3-console-handle
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $pidValue=9056; $c=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId = $pidValue"; if($null -eq $c -or $c.ParentProcessId -ne 32256 -or $c.ExecutablePath -ine 'C:\WINDOWS\system32\conhost.exe' -or ([DateTimeOffset]$c.CreationDate).ToUnixTimeMilliseconds() -ne 1793904693122){throw 'console-helper exact identity changed'}; $owned=[Diagnostics.Process]::GetProcessById($pidValue); $openedHandle=$owned.Handle; @{ready=$true;pid=$pidValue;parent_pid=$c.ParentProcessId;creation_ms=1793904693122;executable=$c.ExecutablePath;handle_opened=($openedHandle -ne 0)} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; [Console]::Out.Flush(); $command=[Console]::ReadLine(); if($command -ne 'wait'){throw 'explicit wait command required'}; $ended=$owned.WaitForExit(15000); @{ended=$ended;has_exited=$owned.HasExited;pid=$pidValue;exit_code=$(if($ended){$owned.ExitCode}else{$null});basis='previously opened exact process handle signaled'} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; [Console]::Out.Flush(); $owned.Dispose(); if(-not $ended){exit 1}
